subject.title: feat(mcp-apps): support bounded model context updates

question: Should an authorized live interactive MCP App be allowed to inject bounded app-controlled text into the next normal model turn without a visible per-update user confirmation?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally bounded and tested, but whether an app may silently influence a subsequent model turn is a product security/trust decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Approve the bounded one-turn contract
options.body: Accept text-only, 16 KiB, in-memory, owner-bound context from authorized live interactive views, consumed once by the next normal turn.

options.title: Require an explicit user-mediated boundary
options.body: Change the design so context is visible to or confirmed by the user before it can affect the next model turn.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded one-turn contract
recommendation.body: Accept text-only, 16 KiB, in-memory, owner-bound context from authorized live interactive views, consumed once by the next normal turn.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently delivered the merged MCP App teardown lifecycle work and authored the current cross-surface implementation.
